assets.title: racing car engine sound loops — loop_0.wav
assets.author: domasx2
assets.fileModifications: Renamed only; the downloaded WAV bytes are unchanged.
assets.runtimeProcessing: 18 ms loop seam crossfade in the decoded buffer; variable playback rate, low-pass filter and gain driven by simulated SUMO vehicle speed.
assets.provenanceNote: The current source page declares CC0 and describes remaking the loop from a public-domain pdsounds sample. Its author comment dated 2011-07-24 confirms the public-domain remake. Historical comments on an earlier replaced source remain on that page.
assets.usageBoundary: Demonstration playback only. It is not a Tangdao Bay microphone recording, a recording of the tracked SUMO vehicle, a validated physical sound model, or an input to real acoustic recognition.
